name: kanban-status-sync
description: Syncs obsidian-kanban board column positions to `status:` frontmatter on moved cards. KanbanStatusSync.syncAllBoards(dv, today) discovers boards via `dv.pages().where(p => p['kanban-plugin'] === 'board')` and calls syncBoard(boardPath, today) for each. syncBoard parses board columns via parseBoardColumns, derives status slugs via slugifyStatus, then performs a forward pass (cards present in board — write status/status_prev/status_changed_at if column changed via app.fileManager.processFrontMatter) + reverse pass (orphaned cards previously linked to this board — mark archived). Idempotent: if nothing changed, no writes. Mobile-safe — never reads file.mtime (landmine #23). Pure static helpers (Node-testable): parseBoardColumns, slugifyStatus, computeDiff (computeDiff is exported for caller composition; syncBoard inlines its own forward/reverse passes rather than composing computeDiff). v0.1.0 (workshop v0.72.0): initial release. Consumed by daily@0.12.0 as a side-effect of SpaceDailyDashboard rendering.
